theme.style: A misty woodland morning rendered as editorial paper: pale celadon and muted sage dissolving into warm cream, with faint dusty terracotta warmth at the horizon. Light is soft and diffused from the upper left, mist drifting in vertical bands, everything matte with fine paper grain and no hard edges. Calm, unhurried, tactile — like a well-printed journal left open on a windowsill. Backgrounds stay quiet so the serif headlines and the device breathe.
